proposal.blind_spot: Current metrics cannot distinguish an unsaturated-DRAM kernel that is parallelism/latency-limited (fixable with more blocks or loads in flight) from one that is truly bandwidth-saturated (only byte reduction or no change helps), nor confirm that warps are actually stalled on global memory.

rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: HIGH -> grid already fills the SMs; stop adding parallelism, reduce DRAM bytes or leave the kernel unchanged to avoid regressions / LOW -> grid too small (e.g., one block per row/channel); split the reduction across more blocks, use smaller tiles or a two-pass scheme to saturate DRAM
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> warps wait on global loads; if DRAM <85% add memory-level parallelism (more loads in flight, prefetch/num_stages, bigger grid), if DRAM ~94% only byte reduction can help so do not rewrite / LOW -> memory latency is not the limiter; stop blaming DRAM and target barriers, synchronization, or instruction mix instead
